objective.name: execution_result
objective.description: Defines the structured operational result returned to cognition when some requested effects succeeded and a subsequent effect failed.

functional._succeeded_note: Ordered collection of references or descriptors for effects that were successfully applied before execution stopped.
functional._failed_note: Required when execution failed. Identifies the effect that could not be applied.
functional._error_note: Required when execution failed. Structured or textual error describing why the failed effect could not be applied.
functional._remaining_note: Optional. Ordered collection of effects from the validated pilot output that were not attempted after execution stopped.
